name: whatsapp-rust-bridge
description: A high-performance utilities for WhatsApp, powered by Rust and WebAssembly.
author: João Lucas <jlucaso@hotmail.com>

scripts.bench: bun run build && bun run benches/binary.ts && bun run benches/signal.ts && bun run benches/curve.ts && bun run benches/crypto.ts
scripts.bench:node: bun run build && node --expose-gc benches/binary.ts && node --expose-gc benches/signal.ts && node --expose-gc benches/curve.ts && node --expose-gc benches/crypto.ts
scripts.build:wasm:simd: rm -rf pkg-simd && WASM_PACK_CACHE=.wasm-pack-cache CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_UNKNOWN_UNKNOWN_RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128' wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg-simd --no-pack
scripts.build:wasm:compat: rm -rf pkg-compat && WASM_PACK_CACHE=.wasm-pack-cache wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg-compat --no-pack
scripts.build:wasm:bundle: rm -rf pkg && cp -R pkg-simd pkg && mv pkg/whatsapp_rust_bridge_bg.wasm pkg/whatsapp_rust_bridge_bg_simd.wasm && cp pkg/whatsapp_rust_bridge_bg_simd.wasm pkg/whatsapp_rust_bridge_bg.wasm && cp pkg-compat/whatsapp_rust_bridge_bg.wasm pkg/whatsapp_rust_bridge_bg_compat.wasm
scripts.build:wasm: bun run build:wasm:simd && bun run build:wasm:compat && bun run build:wasm:bundle && bun run build:wasm:clean
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:ts && bun run postbuild
